name: PUNCH 👊
desc:
🥊 In this chaotic battle, your fists are your greatest weapon. Step onto the platform, throw powerful punches and knock your opponents off the platform to claim victory as the last one standing!

🔧 This game is still in development so bugs are to be expected!

👊 Customize your boxing gloves with unique skins.
🔥 Equip Abilities to give you the upper hand in battle.
🏆 Punch your way to the top.

🎮 CONTROLS:
Punch - Left Click/Tap Screen/Tap Button/R1
Block - Q/Tap Button/L1
Skill - E/Tap Button/ButtonX

Tags: multiplayer, pvp, battle, boxing, punch, minigame, abilities, skills, pc, mobile, console, xbox
